title: EzacianCraft - Thaumcraft Addon
description: An new addon for Thaumcraft 4, which adds a lot of interesting and helpful tools and machines for the way to the thaumaturge, can you dechiper the darks sides of this magic?
body:
**\--DESCRIPTION--**

A Thaumcraft Addon that adds Machines, new Aspects, Wands-Staffs, Multiblocks and much more. With a lot of white and dark magic in his progression and solves a lot of problems which a Thaumaturge can't pass, but this mod solves that.

This mod will add a _LOT of Compatibility_ in the _future_ and a _lot of new content_ for a while; But. This mod is still in too **alpha**, so **expect unfinished content,** a **lot of bugs** and **critical changes** in this state, if you wonder to send a issue; go to issues tab to redirect GitHub and open an issue. Or if you want to make suggestions for the mod, go to GitHub as said before.

This is an addon for thaumcraft, so the dependencies is to download Thaumcraft and Baubles in the latest version for the current minecraft version of the mod to work.

 

**\--LANGUAGES--**

The mod support the currently next Languages:

*   Mexican Spanish (Español Mexicano)
*   United States (American) English

If you want more languages and translations, go to github to receive help, we welcome you with open arms.

 

**\--MODPACKS--**

You can use the mod in any modpack personally.

But if you gonna publish or create one, the only thing to do is credit me and the other autors as put in the license, then you're free of any problem.

 

**\--CREDITS--**

Credits to:
